scope: Official Muscat GIS viewer identity and current-record behavior

viewer.discovery: Official Arabic municipal page links its GIS subsite (نظم المعلومات الجغرافية) to https://gis.mm.gov.om/.
viewer.helpVersionEvidence: Search index reports Help11.pdf published about six years ago.

documentedWorkflow.task: Search for location and data of a parcel using its old plot number (البحث عن موقع و بيانات قطعة الأرض باستخدام الرقم القديم لقطعة الأرض).
documentedWorkflow.input: The help says to enter the old plot number from the cadastral sketch (krooki); its example is 2076.
documentedWorkflow.observedResult: The help screenshot shows Plots (16), a numbered candidate list with OBJECTID values, plus map highlights; the viewer is explicitly documented to return more than one result for an old plot-number search.
documentedWorkflow.selectionSemantics: The help instructs the user to continue to a following step to reach the parcel they seek. Evidence available here does not specify a deterministic ranking, lifecycle field, or automatic current-record rule.
documentedWorkflow.administrativeContext: A separate help screenshot/search result shows Locate Phase with Wilayat Al Seeb, Area Al Mabelah South, and Phase PH2; it establishes these as viewer search/context fields, not that they are applied to old-plot lookup or resolve its duplicates.

identityAssessment.oldPlotNumber: Search key only; one-to-many according to the official viewer documentation.
identityAssessment.objectId: Viewer result/list identifier shown in help; not shown to be a stable cadastral identity or lifecycle discriminator.
identityAssessment.currentRecordRule: Not established by the accessible help evidence.
identityAssessment.duplicateResolution: Human review in the viewer is documented as required after an ambiguous search, but the actual follow-up workflow and evidence a user should compare could not be verified during this run.
identityAssessment.result: Viewer evidence resolves that PAIN/old plot number can be ambiguous; it does not establish a machine-selectable current parcel among overlaps. Do not infer currentness from OBJECTID, display order, or geometry overlap.

adapterRecommendation.now: Keep the readable EnglishWebsite_mmm12c layer blocked from canonical ingestion under its existing identity/completeness gate. Treat old plot number as a lookup key only. Do not merge or choose one overlapping feature as current based on PAIN, OBJECTID, response order, or geometry alone.
adapterRecommendation.possiblePublicPath: Use the documented viewer as a human-assisted lookup/reference surface only; ingestion requires an anonymously readable authoritative layer whose stable native identity and current/historic semantics are explicitly verified, plus a completeness gate.
neededEvidence: The follow-up help step after the 16-result old-number search and any explicit selection criterion.
Viewer network configuration/query endpoints and public layer IDs, if accessible without authentication.
A field or source rule that explicitly marks current versus superseded records, or an official authoritative endpoint with one current record per plot identity.
An identified, sampled viewport audit showing no omitted/ambiguous parcels and agreement with viewer results.

privacy: No geometry, owner attributes, credentials, tokens, or personal paths retained.

layerIdentityMetadata.interpretation: Metadata supplies hierarchical-looking administrative and old/new plot-number fields but declares no parcel UID, composite key, current/superseded field, effective date, or history rule. Field labels alone do not prove a native parcel identity or currentness rule.

newlyReviewedLayer.queryBehavior: All three checks requested grouped attribute counts only, returnGeometry=false; no geometry or attribute tuples are retained here. Their observed duplicates mean these plausible direct field combinations are not unique in this layer.
newlyReviewedLayer.conclusion: No source-backed unique composite native key can be established from this layer. OBJECTID is the only declared unique attribute index, while tested hierarchy/plot combinations repeat. Do not use OBJECTID or an unverified composite to collapse overlapping records; this layer also has no visible lifecycle fields to select a current version.

campingViewerContext.applicationSnippet: THIS MAP IS USED TO show the camping Location in Muscat
campingViewerContext.webMap: MMGISBasemap_WEBMAP, public; it includes MMGISBasemap plus separate CampingLocations and CampingLocationWebLayer operational layers.
campingViewerContext.queryWidget: A configured CampingLocations query filters on WILLAYATCD and operates on its own point FeatureServer layer. The public configuration does not query the Plots sublayer as a parcel-identity search.
campingViewerContext.officialUse: Municipal news says the interactive map lets camping-permit applicants choose designated camping locations. This establishes the use of the public app, not that the basemap plot polygons are a current cadastral register.
